job_post_detail.title: Marketing Trainee (Brand Strategy)-2027校招
job_post_detail.description:
1、Strategic Planning & Execution: Translate strategic recommendations into structured implementation plans, coordinating with cross-functional and regional stakeholders to ensure effective delivery.
2、Brand Positioning & Portfolio Strategy: Support work on brand positioning, TA strategy, value proposition development, and long-term portfolio planning.
3、Performance Analysis & Business Review: Track business and brand performance, develop fact-based analyses, and contribute to management reviews and strategic discussions.
4、Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, marketing, regional, creative, and commercial teams to ensure strategic alignment and effective implementation.
5、Executive Communication & Special Projects: Prepare high-quality presentations and strategic materials for leadership, and support ad hoc strategic initiatives, including new market opportunities, innovation priorities, and long-term brand development.initiatives.
job_post_detail.requirement:
1、Bachelor’s degree or above.
2、Outstanding academic performance and evidence of exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and structured thinking capabilities.
3、1–2 high-quality internships in top-tier strategy consulting firms or in strategy / corporate development / business planning teams at leading internet / technology companies and top-tier 4A agencies.
4、Strong understanding of imaging products and genuine interest in consumer electronics, technology, and global brand building.
5、Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Chinese & English.
6、Proven ability to break down ambiguous problems, develop hypothesis-driven analyses, and derive clear recommendations from data and research.
7、Strong proficiency in PowerPoint / Keynote and Excel / Numbers, with the ability to build well-structured, insight-driven, and executive-ready materials.
